attorneys: Frederick Bernays Wiener and Jacob Kossman for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman, Assistant Attorney General Mclnerney, John F. Davis and Robert S. Erdahl for the United States.

opinions.text: *944On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Per Curiam: The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the Court of Appeals is vacated and the case is remanded to that court for reconsideration in the light of Hoffman v. United States, ante, p. 479.
